name: Glonass-K1? (Kosmos 2621?)
destination_explanation: High enough to see a big piece of the planet and low enough to keep signal delays short, this orbit suits navigation and some internet systems.
slot_a_text: Glonass-K are the third generation of satellite design for GLONASS satellite navigation system. GLONASS is a Russian space-based navigation system comparable to the similar GPS and Galileo systems. This generation improves on accuracy, power consumption and design life.
slot_b_text: That was Russian Space Forces' 7th launch of the year, 159th all time. Soyuz 2.1b/Fregat-M is on a 37-flight success streak. It was the 260th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
og_full_slot_a_text: Glonass-K are the third generation of satellite design for GLONASS satellite navigation system. GLONASS is a Russian space-based navigation system comparable to the similar GPS and Galileo systems. This generation improves on accuracy, power consumption and design life. Each satellite is unpressurized and weighs 935 kg, and has an operational lifetime of 10 years.
